items.q: What does OTS stand for in out-of-home?
items.why: OTS counts people who had the chance to see an ad, not those who definitely did.

items.q: What does PoP stand for in DOOH reporting?
items.why: Proof of play records when and where an ad was shown.
PDOOH is digital out-of-home inventory bought through automated platforms.

items.q: What does CMS stand for on a screen network?
items.why: The CMS is the software that stores ads and tells each screen what to play.
